case_name: Access Now, Inc. v. Blue Apron, LLC
court: U.S. District Court, District of New Hampshire
claim_type: Online meal kit subscription website inaccessible to blind screen reader users; online-only business with no physical stores
outcome: Motion to dismiss denied November 2017; settled 2018 with Blue Apron agreeing to improve website accessibility

sources.name: Bloomberg Law — Blue Apron must defend website access claims
Lexology — Online retailers beware: court holds website violates ADA despite lack of physical store
AudioEye — Breaking down four landmark web accessibility lawsuits

summary_one_line: Online-only business (no physical stores) held to be subject to ADA; court ruled excluding internet-only businesses would 'run afoul of the purposes of the ADA.'
notes: Filed by accessibility organization Access Now on behalf of four plaintiffs with visual disabilities. Judge Laplante's ruling is significant: ADA applies even to businesses with zero physical locations. Settled 2018 — Blue Apron committed to website remediation. Important precedent for any business operating online-only (SaaS, e-commerce, subscription).
